hello.title: 👋 Welcome to Balce, {name}!
hello.body: This short tour shows you around. It takes about a minute. You can skip it, and open it again any time from your account menu.

menu.title: 🧭 Your menu
menu.body: Everything lives here: selling, products, stock, reports and settings. On a phone, open it with the ☰ button at the top.

pos.title: 🛒 Point of Sale
pos.body: Sell here. Search or scan a product, add it to the cart and take payment.

products.title: 📦 Products
products.body: Add what you sell. Pick from the ready list of common products to save time.

users.title: 👥 Users
users.body: Give each cashier their own sign in, so every sale shows who served.

settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
settings.body: Add your logo, phone and receipt text, and switch on extras such as credit (madeni), suppliers and books.

language.title: 🌍 Language
language.body: Switch between English and Kiswahili at any time.

notifications.title: 🔔 Notifications
notifications.body: Low stock and other alerts appear here.

account.title: 👤 Your account
account.body: Settings, help from the Balce team, and this tour again are all here.

start.title: 🚀 Let's get you selling
start.body:
Three steps to start:
1. Settings — your business details
2. Products — what you sell
3. Users — your cashiers
Each page shows a short guide the first time you open it.

tabs.title: 🗂️ Settings sections
tabs.body: Each tab covers one area. Start with Business, then work along the tabs.

business.title: 🏪 Business details
business.body: Your business name, phone, address and TIN print on receipts and invoices. Press Save when you are done.

features.title: 🧩 Features
features.body: Switch on only what your shop needs: customers and credit (madeni), orders, suppliers, money and books. You can change this any time.

branding.title: 🎨 Branding
branding.body: Upload your logo. It prints on receipts, invoices and reports.

hardware.title: 🖨️ Printer and scanner
hardware.body: Connect a receipt printer and test it here.

add.title: ➕ Add a product
add.body: Add items one by one. In the form, “Pick from common products” fills in the name, unit, category and price for you.

import.title: 📥 Import from Excel
import.body: Already have a list? Press Template, fill it in Excel, then Import to add everything at once.

search.title: 🔍 Find a product
search.body: Search by name, SKU or barcode, or filter by category.

next.title: ✅ Ready to sell
next.body: Products with stock appear at the Point of Sale straight away. Change quantities later under Stock.

search.title: 🔍 Find or scan
search.body: Type a name or scan a barcode. Press Enter to add the first match.

products.title: 👆 Tap to add
products.body: Tap a product to put it in the cart. Tap again to add one more.

carts.title: 🛍️ Serve several customers
carts.body: Keep up to three carts open and switch between them while a customer decides.

pay.title: 💵 Take payment
pay.body: Press Pay, choose cash, card or mobile money, and print the receipt.
